名称与原子强迫的有限集合证书

本节所有具名 \(k\) 元谓词均为 \(\mathsf{Var}_{BMM}^{k}\to\mathsf{Frm}_{BMM}\) 的有限宏；辅助绑定变量使用本地fresh序列，避开全部显示实参。\(\operatorname{Val}(h,u,r):=\operatorname{Rel}(h,u,r)\)（各使用处另要求 \(\operatorname{Fun}(h)\)）。

对子名称闭包，\(h(u)\) 恰为子名称秩后继的并。空名称的秩是零。若某节点有两种秩，取其元层集合秩最小的差异节点（子名称的集合秩严格较低），子节点秩相同，显示的成员双条件即迫使两种秩相同。闭包包含在根名称的传递闭包中，因而是集合；逐成员秩构造 \(h\) 后替代收集得到证书。\(\operatorname{NameRank}\) 的原递归式由这个有限公式推出，而不再是定义右端的自调用。

以下两个右端不含递归宏；\(T\) 只是一个集合参数。

下降测度不用自然和。对两名称秩 \(\alpha,\beta\)，取有序对 \((\max(\alpha,\beta),\min(\alpha,\beta))\) 的字典序：先比较第一分量，第一相等才比较第二。\(\max\) 是包含另一序数的那一个，\(\min\) 是另一个；两序数相等时两分量相同。每次调用减少一个名称秩，交换两名称不改变测度，所以严格下降。给定 \(S\) 的秩上界，这个测度域是集合且良序；在每一层，ER/IR右端只读更低层的表，故用分离得到本层，替代收集所有层。两个证书若首次在某测度处分歧，右端读值全同，矛盾。对两个不同闭包取并闭包并比较，根部真值也同；因此定义不依赖证书选择。

每支只调用真子式的quotation，终止测度为公式树节点数。它给出原有编码图在固定公式实例上的精确对象公式；不把元自然数 \(i\) 当作对象项，也不引入统一真谓词。派生缩写先全部展开。

((\operatorname{Tag}_{0}(z)\lor\operatorname{Tag}_{1}(z))\land\operatorname{Key}(k,p,m,n)\land\operatorname{OrdPair}(t,z,k))
\land\forall p\in P\forall m\in S\forall n\in S
\bigl((\operatorname{E}(T,p,m,n)\leftrightarrow\operatorname{ER}(T,P,R,p,m,n))\land
(\operatorname{I}(T,p,m,n)\leftrightarrow\operatorname{IR}(T,P,R,p,m,n))\bigr).

\operatorname{ForceNameEq}(P,R,p,m,n):=\operatorname{Poset}(P,R)\land p\in P\land
\exists S\exists h\exists T(\operatorname{NC}(S,h,P)\land m\in S\land n\in S\land
\operatorname{AtomCert}(T,S,P,R)\land\operatorname{E}(T,p,m,n)),

\operatorname{ForceNameIn}(P,R,p,m,n):=\operatorname{Poset}(P,R)\land p\in P\land
\exists S\exists h\exists T(\operatorname{NC}(S,h,P)\land m\in S\land n\in S\land
\operatorname{AtomCert}(T,S,P,R)\land\operatorname{I}(T,p,m,n)).

\operatorname{NameUpd}(a,i,n,b,P):=\operatorname{NameAssign}(a,P)\land\operatorname{NameAssign}(b,P)\land
\operatorname{Name}(n,P)\land\exists w(\operatorname{Omega}(w)\land i\in w)\land
\forall j\forall m\bigl(\operatorname{Rel}(b,j,m)\leftrightarrow
((j\doteq i\land m\doteq n)\lor(j\ne i\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j,m)))\bigr).

F_{v_i\doteq v_j}:=\exists i'\exists j'\exists m\exists n
(\operatorname{Tag}_{i}(i')\land\operatorname{Tag}_{j}(j')\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,i',m)\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j',n)\land\operatorname{ForceNameEq}(P,R,p,m,n)),

F_{v_i\in v_j}:=\exists i'\exists j'\exists m\exists n
(\operatorname{Tag}_{i}(i')\land\operatorname{Tag}_{j}(j')\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,i',m)\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j',n)\land\operatorname{ForceNameIn}(P,R,p,m,n)),

F_{\forall v_i B}(P,R,p,a):=\exists i'(\operatorname{Tag}_{i}(i')\land
\forall n(\operatorname{Name}(n,P)\to\forall b(\operatorname{NameUpd}(a,i',n,b,P)\to F_B(P,R,p,b)))),

\operatorname{Club}(C,\kappa):=\operatorname{Ord}(\kappa)\land C\subseteq\kappa\land
\forall a\in\kappa\exists b\in C(a\in b)\land
\forall\delta\in\kappa\bigl((\operatorname{Ord}(\delta)\land\neg\operatorname{Empty}(\delta)\land
\forall a\in\delta\exists b\in\delta(a\in b)\land
\forall a\in\delta\exists b\in C(b\in\delta\land a\in b))\to\delta\in C\bigr).

\operatorname{Check}(n,x,P):=\exists D\exists g
(\operatorname{Trans}(D)\land x\in D\land\operatorname{Fun}(g)\land\operatorname{Dom}(g,D)\land\operatorname{Rel}(g,x,n)\land
\forall y\in D\exists u(\operatorname{Rel}(g,y,u)\land
\forall q(q\in u\leftrightarrow\exists z\in y\exists v\exists s\in P
(\operatorname{Rel}(g,z,v)\land\operatorname{OrdPair}(q,v,s))))),

\land\ \forall n\bigl(\operatorname{Name}(n,P)\to
\exists a\exists c_{\mathsf{club}}\exists c_{\mathsf{hit}}(\operatorname{NameAssign}(a,P)\land
\operatorname{Rel}(a,e_0,n)\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,e_1,\bar\kappa)\land
\operatorname{Rel}(a,e_2,\bar S)
\land\operatorname{Quote}_{BMM}(\operatorname{Club}(v_0,v_1),c_{\mathsf{club}})
\land\operatorname{Quote}_{BMM}(\exists v_3(v_3\in v_2\land v_3\in v_0),c_{\mathsf{hit}})

\land\ (\operatorname{Forces}_{\operatorname{Club}(v_0,v_1)}(P,R,p,c_{\mathsf{club}},a)
\to\forall r\in P(\operatorname{Rel}(R,r,p)\to\exists q\in P(
\operatorname{Rel}(R,q,r)\land
\operatorname{Forces}_{\exists v_3(v_3\in v_2\land v_3\in v_0)}(P,R,q,c_{\mathsf{hit}},a))))\bigr))).

\operatorname{CodeClosed}(C,w):=
\forall i\in w\forall j\in w\exists c\in C(
\operatorname{EqCode}(c,i,j)\land\exists d\in C\,\operatorname{MemCode}(d,i,j))

\land\ \forall d\in C\,\exists c\in C\,\operatorname{NegCode}(c,d)
\land\ \forall d\in C\forall e\in C\,\exists c\in C\,\operatorname{ImpCode}(c,d,e)
\land\ \forall i\in w\forall d\in C\,\exists c\in C\,\operatorname{AllCode}(c,i,d),

\operatorname{Upd}(a,i,x,b,u,w):=
\operatorname{Assign}(a,u,w)\land\operatorname{Assign}(b,u,w)\land
i\in w\land x\in u\land\operatorname{Rel}(b,i,x)\land
\forall j\forall y((j\ne i\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j,y))\to\operatorname{Rel}(b,j,y)).

\operatorname{SatCert}_{BMM}(T,u,C,w):=\operatorname{Omega}(w)\land\operatorname{Code}_{BMM}(C,w)\land
\forall q\in T\exists e\in C\exists s(\operatorname{Assign}(s,u,w)\land\operatorname{OrdPair}(q,e,s))\land
\forall e\in C\forall a(\operatorname{Assign}(a,u,w)\to(\operatorname{Holds}(T,e,a)\leftrightarrow\Bigl(

\exists i\in w\exists j\in w\bigl(
\operatorname{EqCode}(e,i,j)\land
\exists x\exists y(\operatorname{Rel}(a,i,x)\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j,y)\land x\doteq y)\bigr)

\lor\ \exists i\in w\exists j\in w\bigl(
\operatorname{MemCode}(e,i,j)\land
\exists x\exists y(\operatorname{Rel}(a,i,x)\land\operatorname{Rel}(a,j,y)\land x\in y)\bigr)

\lor\ \exists i\in w\exists c\in C\bigl(
\operatorname{AllCode}(e,i,c)\land
\forall x\in u\forall b(
\operatorname{Upd}(a,i,x,b,u,w)\to
\operatorname{Holds}(T,c,b))\bigr)
\Bigr))).

\operatorname{DZClosed}(Z,w):=
\forall i\in w\forall j\in w\bigl(
\exists e\in Z\,\operatorname{EqCode}(e,i,j)\land
\exists m\in Z\,\operatorname{MemCode}(m,i,j)\bigr)

\land\ \forall c\in Z\forall e(\operatorname{NegCode}(e,c)\to e\in Z)
\land\ \forall c\in Z\forall d\in Z\forall e(\operatorname{ImpCode}(e,c,d)\to e\in Z)

\land\ \forall i\in w\forall j\in w\forall c\in Z\forall e(
\operatorname{BallCode}(e,i,j,c)\to e\in Z).

\operatorname{DeltaZero}(e)\Longleftrightarrow
\exists w\exists C\exists Z(
\operatorname{Omega}(w)\land\operatorname{CodeSet}(C,w)\land Z\subseteq C\land
\operatorname{DZClosed}(Z,w)\land
\forall Y((Y\subseteq C\land\operatorname{DZClosed}(Y,w))\to Z\subseteq Y)\land e\in Z).

\operatorname{Filter}(G,P,R):=\neg\operatorname{Empty}(G)\land G\subseteq P\land
\forall p\in G\forall q\in P(\operatorname{Rel}(R,p,q)\to q\in G)
\land\forall p\in G\forall q\in G\exists r\in G(
\operatorname{Rel}(R,r,p)\land\operatorname{Rel}(R,r,q)),

\operatorname{MaxAntichain}(A,P,R):=A\subseteq P\land
\forall p\in A\forall q\in A(\operatorname{Compat}(p,q,P,R)\to p\doteq q)
\land\forall p\in P\exists q\in A\,\operatorname{Compat}(p,q,P,R),

\operatorname{MeetAll}(G,\mathcal A):=
\forall A\in\mathcal A\,\exists p(p\in G\land p\in A).

\mathsf{Ax}_{BMM}=
\{\forall P\forall R\forall\mathcal A(
(\operatorname{SSP}(P,R)\land\operatorname{BoundedAF}_{\omega_1}(\mathcal A,P,R))
\to\exists G(\operatorname{Filter}(G,P,R)\land\operatorname{MeetAll}(G,\mathcal A))):
P,R,\mathcal A,G\in\mathsf{Var}_{BMM},|\{P,R,\mathcal A,G\}|=4\}.
